notes.title: Chinese, Indonesian, and Korean language support update!
notes.notes:
Jumpscare Simulator is now fully playable in the following languages!

- Simplified Chinese

- Indonesian

- Korean

Thank you so much to everyone from these countries who purchased and showed great interest in the game. I was aware of your requests for language support and didn’t want to leave them unanswered!

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Day One Update
notes.notes:
Day One Update

With the first-day update, the following issues have been completely fixed:

- The issue of switches turning on and off in the final section.
- Puzzle pieces falling into unreachable areas during interactions.
- Minor visual issues.
- Music and sound balance problems.

Additionally:
Some extra support has been added to improve the user experience.

I am working hard to provide you with a better experience. Please don't hesitate to report any bugs you encounter.
